description: This file contains shell script functions and logic for handling firmware upgrades specific to Buffalo devices using U-Boot and NAND flash. It includes functions for verifying images, checking board-specific magic numbers, and performing upgrade procedures conditionally based on image type.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image by checking TRX magic numbers, verifying tar archive integrity, and matching kernel size with partition size.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Performs upgrade of TRX+UBI formatted images on NAND flash, including detachment of UBI and erasure of firmware partition.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines image type based on magic number and delegates to the appropriate upgrade method.
